description: Solve an early church Bible crossword: the breaking of bread, all things common, Stephen the first martyr, and the deacons. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: Three thousand souls added in a day, and then the ordinary business of being a church: continuing in the apostles' doctrine, breaking bread from house to house, and having all things common. The Early Church covers Acts 2 to 8 — Ananias and Sapphira, the seven chosen to serve tables, Stephen's speech and his stoning, and the scattering that spread the gospel further than staying ever would have.
The clues assume the book rather than the highlights, which puts this one in the Hard tier. The closing verse is the description of how they lived together.
